title: Dynamic Smart Mining network: auto-rotates across unsaturated belts (>=15% floor), prioritizing reserve deficits and tool match
note: Policy-driven autonomous Mining runner governed by game/mine-policy.json (Zero/Unity). Matches fitted tools (mining laser, ice harvester, gas harvester), prioritizes needs.tsv/supply_chains deficits while skipping full reserves, enforces live 15% regrowth floor in flight with instant cooldown rotation, and caps <=3 ships/belt atomically. 2026-11-24 14:51 UTC (Zero): max_ships 90 -> 3 and requires.empire voidborn: a test of three before any lift (F37). mine_net.py read no field since its launch (the stations query named columns read.db lacks; fixed by fleet-build the same turn), so every run rested without mining; the policy deposits only at the five home stations where give routes of ours collect (deposit_stations).
